action_items: (Minor, not related to bug fix) Squadre section uses id='squadre' but the review request expected data-testid='squadre' on the section wrapper. The team cards do use data-testid='team-card-<id>' correctly. Consider adding data-testid='squadre' to the section for consistency with SocialWall.

(Minor) Team cards appear to be rendered twice in the DOM (10 nodes for 5 unique teams). Likely two responsive views or a duplicated marquee/track element. Verify only one set is visible per breakpoint; otherwise deduplicate to avoid double network fetches (each team image was loaded twice).

(Unrelated console warning) React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> in components/site/TrialForm.jsx line 70 (courses map). Wrap the dynamic label without a <span> wrapper inside <option>.
(Unrelated) Two 401 responses observed during page load (likely optional admin/session probe). Confirm public homepage doesn't call an auth-required endpoint.
critical_code_review_comments: Bug fix verified: DB content served via GET /api/content no longer contains ice-hockey Pexels URLs. Rendered DOM confirms correct floorball imagery site-wide.
